content: It would be more fair to have this pulley diagram before any belt routing through the y axis motor.

Can’t stress enough what’s stated here: „ When installing the belts into the carriage, verify that all four belt ends have the exact same number of protruding teeth from the carriage.“. This is one of the most important task to take care when securing the new belts, in chapters 40 ff.
Notice that the circled images in the upper corners are mirrored. But that's OK since using a mirror is pretty much the only way to see that at this stage.
